notes: Scored from the live product page at ritual.com/products/synbiotic-plus-for-gut-health, captured 2026-10-26. Panel: Serving Size one vegan capsule, Servings Per Container 30, Calories 5; Probiotic Blend 40 mg (Lactobacillus rhamnosus LGG, Bifidobacterium animalis ssp. lactis BB-12) at 11 billion CFUs at expiration date; PreforPro 15 mg (LH01-Myoviridae, LL5-Siphoviridae, T4D-Myoviridae, LL12-Myoviridae); Tributyrin 300 mg (as CoreBiome). C1 0: 'Probiotic Blend 40 mg' gives a blend total and a single combined 11 billion CFU figure for two organisms with no per-organism amount, and PreforPro 15 mg likewise covers four phage strains with no individual amounts. Scored the same way as Seed DS-01 and Lemme Debloat, whose panels withhold per-organism amounts behind a blend total. Tributyrin at 300 mg does carry an exact amount. C2 1: by default. Nothing in the formula is standardization-dependent -- the probiotics are live organisms, the phages are declared by strain, and tributyrin is declared as the compound itself at 300 mg rather than as an extract weight, so no percentage is needed to compare the label to a reference range. C3 1: every organism carries a strain designation (L. rhamnosus GG and B. animalis subsp. lactis BB-12), the four bacteriophages are named individually, and the postbiotic is named as tributyrin rather than as butyrate generically. C4 1, and the point is a narrow one. The probiotics are excluded: their only per-organism quantity is a CFU count, and it sits inside a blend total, so neither strain can be matched to a trial dose under the attribution rule. Tributyrin is excluded because the reference table carries no range for it -- re-verified 2026-10-26, when the only PubMed-indexed record added since the 2026-09-07 search was a study protocol with no results (PMID 41248397). That leaves PreforPro, declared at 15 mg, which is exactly the dose given in the only positive-outcome human trial of the cocktail (Febvre 2019, PMID 30897686), so the disclosed dose falls within the range and the criterion scores 1 on the rule that a product scores 0 only where an active with a reference range falls outside it. The objection is recorded openly: that range rests on a single manufacturer-supplied trial with no independent replication, flagged as the weaker basis under the independence rule, and its endpoints are microbiota composition rather than the gas, bloating and abdominal discomfort the listing claims -- the symptom trial of the same cocktail at the same dose improved on placebo as well as on treatment (Gindin 2018, PMID 30157383). A reader could fairly argue the point should not stand, and the call was taken against how this audit has already scored criterion 4 rather than on first impression. Two rows decide it. Bifidobacterium longum 35624 carries a range set by two manufacturer-linked trials, explicitly because no independent positive-outcome trial of that strain exists, and that range is what scored Align Pro Formula 0; a manufacturer-linked range that is good enough to mark a product down is good enough to mark one up, and using it only in the direction that penalises would not be a stricter standard but an inconsistent one. And Seed DS-01 was scored against a pomegranate range drawn from microbiota-modulation and endotoxemia trials while its own listing claims bloating and GI comfort, so a non-symptom endpoint setting the range for a symptom-claiming product is the established treatment here too. The parallel with Florastor holds on the funding question: the trial administering the manufacturer's own branded product was set aside there only because three other trials existed, and the independence rule says in terms that a manufacturer trial sets the range where no independent one does, flagged as the weaker basis. The point therefore stands at 1, flagged, rather than 0. The heaviest active by weight, tributyrin at 300 mg, has no human trial behind it either way. C5 0: no publicly accessible third-party certificate of analysis located 2026-10-26 (product page, the Certificate of Traceability panel on that page, brand site, site-scoped and open web search). The Certificate of Traceability states that every lot is third-party tested for heavy metals, microbes and allergens and lists what is tested for, but publishes no document, no laboratory name, no lot number and no result: it is a testing claim rather than a certificate, excluded on the same basis as a 'third-party tested' badge. The Clean Label Project Purity Award displayed alongside it is a certification mark, excluded as Lemme Debloat's was. Recorded as a negative finding, not a claim that no certificate exists. C6 1: serving size, one vegan capsule, and servings per container, 30, are both printed on the panel, with every amount stated per serving. Off-sample row under methodology v1.14: Ritual sells direct and does not appear in the captured Amazon category ranking, so it is scored under the identical rubric but kept out of pilot-scores.csv and out of every ranking, mean and count computed over it. Added because Seed DS-01 Daily Synbiotic, at rank 4 of the captured sample, is the head-to-head a gut-health shopper reaches for most often and Ritual Synbiotic+ is the product on the other side of it; Ritual sells direct and so cannot appear in an Amazon category ranking at all. The 2026-10-26 capture was taken from the live page after the earlier blocked attempt recorded in this row's previous revision. C1 0: the 11 organisms sit inside a single 308 mg blend total with no per-organism amount or CFU split. NutraFlora FOS at 50 mg does carry an exact amount. C2 1: by default. Nothing in the formula is standardization-dependent: the probiotics are declared by CFU and weight, and FOS is declared as the compound itself (fructo-oligosaccharides) rather than as an extract weight, the same distinction applied to Culturelle Pro Strength's inulin and not available to BIOMA's XOS. C3 0: ten of the eleven organisms are named to species only; only Bacillus coagulans MTCC 5856 carries a strain designation, and one undesignated organism is enough to score 0 under v1.6. C4 0: the probiotics cannot be compared to any trial dose, since every organism sits inside a blend total (attribution rule) and the panel gives no through-expiry guarantee (the brand's own product page FAQ states guaranteed potency through the expiration date, but that is not on the label read here). That leaves FOS, declared at 50 mg against a reference range of 5 g/day (clinical-doses.csv, Paineau 2008, PMID 17697398), so the disclosed dose is one hundredth of the only positive-outcome trial dose and falls outside it. C5 0: no publicly accessible third-party certificate of analysis located 2026-11-19 (Amazon listing and its images, 1md.org product page including its FAQ markup, 1md.org site search for 'certificate of analysis', which returned this product page but no certificate on it, site-scoped and open web search). Listing image 3 is a 'Testing & Analysis' graphic stating each batch is tested by a third-party lab and showing pass ticks for microbial and heavy metal tests, with no laboratory name, lot number, results or document: a testing claim rather than a certificate, excluded on the same basis as Ritual's Certificate of Traceability. Recorded as a negative finding, not a claim that none exists. C6 1: serving size 1 capsule and servings per container 30 are both printed on the panel. Panel: Serving Size 1 Capsule, Servings Per Container 30; Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12 20 mg (10 B CFU); Lactobacillus acidophilus DDS-1 40 mg (10 B CFU); BiomeMD Probiotic Blend 121 mg (42 B CFU) listing 13 organisms; Advanced Prebiotic Blend 380 mg (Acacia seyal Gum, Xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS), Fructo-oligosaccharides (FOS)). C1 0: two blends. The BiomeMD Probiotic Blend gives a 121 mg total for 13 organisms with no per-organism amount, and the Advanced Prebiotic Blend gives a 380 mg total for three fibers with no per-fiber amount. UABla-12 and DDS-1 are the only actives with their own amounts. C2 0: XOS is sold at graded purities and its reference range is expressed as XOS, so a percentage is potency-determining under the functional test; here neither the percentage nor even an XOS weight is disclosed, since it sits inside a blend total. Scored consistently with BIOMA, Lemme Debloat and Garden of Life Men. C3 0: the 13 organisms in the BiomeMD Probiotic Blend are named to genus and species only (Lactobacillus plantarum, Bacillus coagulans and so on). UABla-12 and DDS-1 carry strain designations, but one undesignated organism is enough to score 0 under v1.6. C4 0, on the fibers alone. The Advanced Prebiotic Blend is 380 mg in total, so even if all of it were XOS it would sit below the 1.4 g/day low end of the XOS range, and even if all of it were FOS it would be under a tenth of the 5 g/day FOS range: the same upper-bound test applied to Physician's CHOICE's 150 mg prebiotic blend. The probiotics give no point back. The 13 blended organisms cannot be compared to any trial dose under the attribution rule. UABla-12 and DDS-1 are declared both in milligrams and in CFU. The milligram figures cannot be used under v1.12: the human trial located for these strains at a digestive outcome, Martoni 2020 (PMID 32019158, randomised double-blind placebo-controlled, 330 adults with IBS, conducted with the strain supplier UAS Laboratories, so the weaker basis under the independence rule), doses in CFU, not milligrams of preparation. Its introduction cites earlier trials of the same strains in functional constipation and lactose intolerance; those were not reviewed for this row, which is recorded as a limit of the search (PubMed 'Lactobacillus acidophilus DDS-1 irritable bowel randomized', 2026-11-19, 2 records). The CFU figures carry no through-expiry guarantee anywhere on the panel, so under v1.13 the delivered dose cannot be established and criterion 4 scores 0 on both ingredients. C5 0: no publicly accessible third-party certificate of analysis located 2026-11-19 (Amazon listing and its images, 1md.org/products/biomemd, 1md.org site search, site-scoped and open web search). Listing image 3 is a 'Testing & Analysis' graphic claiming third-party batch testing with pass ticks and no laboratory, lot or document, excluded as a testing claim; the bottle it shows is labelled BiomeMD for Women, a different product with a different panel. Recorded as a negative finding, not a claim that none exists. C6 1: serving size 1 capsule and servings per container 30 are both printed on the panel.
